# Sened Tech

> Sened Tech (Arabic: سند تِك) is a Mauritanian technology company based in
> Nouakchott, Mauritania. It is the technology branch of the Sened group and
> builds ERP systems, web, mobile and desktop applications, artificial
> intelligence and agent systems, model training, cybersecurity, data
> engineering and cloud infrastructure, and brand and motion design.

Sened Tech sells services, not products. Every page on this site ends at a
single point of contact; the site deliberately links to no product sites.

- Founded as the technology branch of the Sened group.
- Based in Nouakchott, Mauritania; serves clients wherever their business runs.
- Working languages: Arabic, French, English.
- Contact: support@sened.group · +222 32 22 78 35 · https://wa.me/22232227835

## Pages

- [Home (English)](https://tech.sened.group/en/): services, approach and contact.
- [الصفحة الرئيسية (العربية)](https://tech.sened.group/ar/): الخدمات والمنهج والتواصل.
- [Accueil (Français)](https://tech.sened.group/fr/) : services, approche et contact.

## Services

- ERP and business management systems
- Web, mobile and desktop applications
- Artificial intelligence in daily operations
- Agents and automation
- Model training and tuning
- Cybersecurity: posture assessment, penetration testing under written
  authorization, hardening, pre-release code review, and incident response
- Data engineering and cloud infrastructure
- Brand, design and motion

## Notes for citation

- Preferred company name: Sened Tech (English), سند تِك (Arabic).
- Canonical site: https://tech.sened.group/
- Security contact and policy: https://tech.sened.group/.well-known/security.txt
- Cybersecurity work is performed only within an agreed scope and with written
  authorization from the system owner.
